description: This file contains unit tests and test case classes for the 'runfvp' script and related configuration, including tests for running FVP images, configuration file validation, and the FVP runner.

classes.name: RunFVPTests
classes.description: Test case class for testing the 'runfvp' script functionalities, including help, bad options, auto tests, options, and environment tests.

classes.name: ConfFileTests
classes.description: Test case class for testing configuration file loading and validation.

classes.name: RunnerTests
classes.description: Test case class for testing the FVP runner's start method and environment variable handling.

methods.name: run_fvp
methods.description: Executes the 'runfvp' script with specified arguments and environment, verifying success or failure.

methods.name: test_help
methods.description: Tests that the help message contains 'Run images in a FVP'.

methods.name: test_bad_options
methods.description: Tests that invalid options cause failure.

methods.name: test_run_auto_tests
methods.description: Runs all auto-*.json test cases found in the test directory.

methods.name: test_no_exe
methods.description: Tests that loading a config without 'exe' raises ValueError.

methods.name: test_minimal
methods.description: Tests loading a minimal configuration with 'exe' set.

methods.name: test_start
methods.description: Tests starting the FVP process with specific configuration.

methods.name: test_env_passthrough
methods.description: Tests environment variables passed through to the FVP process.
